_README: Symbol overlay for DepSentry live (--live) scanning.
WHY THIS EXISTS: OSV.dev's PyPI advisories carry no affected-symbol data.
Measured 2026-07-31: 0 of 171 sampled PyPI advisories had symbols, across
requests, urllib3, django, pyyaml, jinja2, numpy and pillow. The Go
ecosystem populates ecosystem_specific.imports[].symbols well; Python's
advisory sources do not populate it at all. Without an overlay, every live
PyPI advisory resolves to UNKNOWN and reachability contributes nothing.
TWO MAPS, DIFFERENT TRUST LEVELS:
by_advisory  Exact advisory-ID -> symbols. High confidence. Used by
default. Key on the OSV id (GHSA-…/PYSEC-…) or a CVE alias.
Ships EMPTY: entries are factual claims about specific
advisories and must be curated against the advisory text,
not guessed. Add your own as you verify them.
by_package   Package -> known dangerous API surface. This is a HEURISTIC,
not a per-advisory fact: it attributes a package's risky
entry points to any advisory on that package, which will
sometimes be wrong. It is therefore OPT-IN, enabled only
with --overlay-heuristic. It errs toward marking findings
REACHABLE (a false positive) rather than hiding them.
The entries below are well-documented dangerous APIs of each library --
statements about the library's own interface, not about any CVE.
